25A1162   DARDEN, DUSTIN V. LaFRANCE, SUZANNE, ET AL. 
  The application for injunction addressed to Justice Thomas 
and referred to the Court is denied. 
163, ORIG.   FLORIDA V. CALIFORNIA, ET AL. 
  The motion for leave to file a bill of complaint is denied.   
Justice Thomas, with whom Justice Alito joins, dissenting from
 denial of motion for leave to file complaint: I dissent for the
 reasons given in Nebraska v. Colorado, 577 U. S. 1211 (2016) 
(Thomas, J., dissenting from denial of motion for leave to file
 complaint).
